data.name: The Calamity Trials
data.detailed_description:
THE SCREEN

The screen will have everything you need to begin the trials. You will enter your mind in a world we create. You will feel and experience everything as if you're truly there. We won't be checking in too often since there are plenty of other subjects, but I can assure you that trying to leave the chair by force won't work. Little tip: don't stare at the screen too long since you'll be here awhile, for your sanity.

THE TRIALS

It's too late to turn back; you signed the papers, remember? The trials are what you chose over the death sentence. You'll be tasked to complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles. Reach the end goal before IT catches up to you. These weapons will either help you increase speed and further the gap from IT, or become another obstacle you must overcome. Being caught by IT or falling into the void will result in FAILURE. The only way to win is by reaching the LIGHT at the very end of the stage. I can't provide too much information on what we're preparing for until you complete the trials, but I will say you are not ready for what's to come.

THE KHRON

Khrons is a currency that allows you to unlock stages when you have the required amount. You receive 1000 khrons every stage completed. If you FAIL a stage, you will lose 100 khrons. This provides you 10 opportunities to complete a stage.

THE DOOR

Stages are still a work in progress, but we have plenty of time. Until we feel you are ready or have the required amount of khrons, the door remains CLOSED!
